description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Templatelexer', which implements a lexer for the Smarty template engine. It is responsible for tokenizing template source code, handling different parsing states like TEXT, TAG, LITERAL, and various other token types specific to Smarty syntax. The class includes methods for lexing, state management, and pattern matching of Smarty template constructs.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Templatelexer
classes.description: Lexer class for tokenizing Smarty template source code, managing parsing states, token recognition, and pattern matching for Smarty syntax elements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the lexer with the source template string and the compiler instance, sets up necessary patterns and state.

methods.description: Replaces placeholders in patterns with runtime delimiter patterns.

methods.name: yypushstate
methods.description: Pushes a new lexer state onto the stack and switches to it, with optional tracing.

methods.name: yypopstate
methods.description: Pops the current lexer state, returning to the previous state, with optional tracing.

methods.description: Sets the lexer to a specific state, with optional tracing.
